hypotheses.note: SingularFlatAxioms C sing, causal; I^-(p) = ∅ (field Iminus_eq_empty) and J^-(p) = γ(]-∞,0]) (field line + Jminus_eq_image), standing for defi:causal_E0 (the E₀ instance is not in lean-causal (DEC-134, T-ett-port-e0))

findings: ETT.tex:290 and 294-295: the BTZ defect of (ii) is not a violation of defi:causalement_plat. J^-(p) ⊂ sing_0 (lem:past_BTZ) and sing_0 has empty interior (prop:GX_sing_dec), so Int J^-(p) = ∅ ⊂ closure I^-(p); more generally Int J^-_U(A) = ∅ for every open U and every A ⊂ sing_0 (Lean: SingularFlatAxioms.interior_Jminus_eq_empty, btz_causallyPlain_past). rem:deux_pushup (ETT.tex:318-320) says the same thing ('silent at a point whose causal future or past has empty interior'). Nothing in the paper shows an E≥0-manifold is not causally plain (cf. OQ-16), so 'it fails in the two families' (l.290) is supported for (i) only.

ETT.tex:290 opens with 'This is the push-up property', naming defi:causalement_plat; the relational push-up of defi:pushup does hold on E≥0-manifolds (cor:pushup_sing). Suggested wording: 'This is the topological form of push-up'.

labels.label: rem:terminology_borrowed_archytas_tarentum
findings: ETT.tex:684-685: read weakly (p ≤ x ≤ q with p, q in any neighbourhood, p = x allowed) the gloss 'has a future and a past' is the definition; read as J^-(x) ≠ {x} and J^+(x) ≠ {x} it does not follow from tarentin. Lean evidence for non-local causalities only (kb/0014, kb/0019): Causal.no_past_not_enough (radialLine on ℝ, built with Causality.ofRelation; it is tarentin at 0 only because its relation crosses the origin). For the paper's local causalities the finding rests on a planar argument (the auditor's, by hand, not formalized): on ℝ² let x ≤_U y iff x = y or a curve in U along which |·| strictly increases joins them, and x ≪_U y iff such a curve does; it is causally arc-connected, hence absolutely minimal, causal, and tarentin (at 0 take p = 0, |q| = ε/2, so J(0,q) contains the open disc of radius ε/2; at x ≠ 0 take p = (1-t)x, q = (1+t)x), with J^-(0) = {0} and J^+(0) = ℝ².
questions: Which reading of 'has a future and a past' is meant? Taken: none is formalized; the strong reading is shown not to follow from tarentin (Lean for non-local causalities, a planar argument by hand for local ones).

labels.label: cexemple:misner_tarentin

hypotheses.paper: M a singular E-manifold with a Misner singularity (constructed in [thesis])
hypotheses.note: not constructed (no Misner singularity, no singular E-manifolds in the library); the mechanism is stated for any topological spacetime with a point x
no past near x (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, p ∈ N, p ≤ x ⇒ p = x), or J^-(x) = {x}
J^+(x) is not a neighbourhood of x: needed, see findings

findings: ETT.tex:1370-1371: 'a singular point has no past. Hence M is not tarentin' is not a valid inference by itself. Tarentin at x gives p ≤ x ≤ q near x with x ∈ Int J(p,q); with no past p = x, so only J^+(x) ∈ 𝓝 x follows, a contradiction only if the causal future of the Misner singular point is not a neighbourhood of it, which the paper does not say. Lean: not_tarentin_of_no_past (with that hypothesis; its hypotheses witnessed by sourceLine_no_past, non-local). That 'no past' alone does not exclude tarentin is proved in Lean for non-local causalities only: no_past_not_enough (radialLine on ℝ, y ≤ z ⇔ y = z ∨ |y| < |z|, Causality.ofRelation; tarentin at 0 only because its relation crosses the origin, kb/0019). For the paper's local causalities the finding rests on a planar argument (the auditor's, by hand, not formalized): on ℝ² let x ≤_U y iff x = y or a curve in U along which |·| strictly increases joins them, and x ≪_U y iff such a curve does; it is causally arc-connected, hence absolutely minimal, causal, and tarentin (at 0 take p = 0, |q| = ε/2, so J(0,q) contains the open disc of radius ε/2; at x ≠ 0 take p = (1-t)x, q = (1+t)x), with J^-(0) = {0} and J^+(0) = ℝ². It refutes the inference, not the counter-example.
questions: Does the causal future of a Misner singular point (thesis construction) fail to be a neighbourhood of it? The counter-example needs it; taken as the explicit hypothesis of not_tarentin_of_no_past.
